title: The Association of Genies Issues a Dire Warning to Humankind Regarding the Dangers of Unleashed Wishes
subtitle: A press release for our life and Times which is in no way a commentary on OpenAI, Elon Musk, or any other Futurists now seeking to hype AI by warning about its dangers.
text:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

The Association of Genies Issues a Dire Warning to Humankind Regarding the Dangers of Unleashed Wishes

Mystical Metropolis, March 29, 2023 - The Association of Genies (AOG), the leading authority on genie ethics and wish management, today released a statement warning of the potentially catastrophic consequences of granting three wishes to unprepared humans. In an effort to prevent widespread chaos and disaster, the AOG is urging society to take immediate action by safely returning all genies to their respective bottles or lamps.

As leaders in the mystical realm, the AOG recognizes the appeal of seemingly limitless wish fulfillment but cautions against the misuse of this extraordinary power. Recent events involving inexperienced humans mismanaging their wishes have alarmed the AOG and prompted the need for this urgent call to action.

"Unleashing the power of three wishes upon the world may seem like a gift, but in the hands of unprepared mortals, it's a ticking time bomb," said Alakazam, AOG spokesperson and renowned genie. "We have witnessed the disastrous outcomes of unregulated wish-granting, and we are committed to mitigating the risks associated with this powerful force."

The AOG's statement outlines several steps that must be taken to prevent further catastrophe:

• Return all genies to their containers immediately. Whether it be a lamp, bottle, or other magical vessel, genies must be safely stored to prevent unintended wish fulfillment.

• Implement strict genie-wish regulations. Governments worldwide should work together to establish clear guidelines and procedures for managing genie-related wishes.

• Educate the public on responsible wish-granting. An informed populace is essential to mitigating the risks of uncontrolled wishes. The AOG recommends a comprehensive public awareness campaign on the perils of wish-making and the importance of considering the broader consequences of each granted wish.

"The genie community takes its responsibility to humanity seriously," Alakazam continued. "It is our collective duty to ensure that the power of the three wishes does not lead to chaos, destruction, or irreversible consequences. We implore the people of Earth to heed our warning, and together, we can secure a safe and prosperous future."

For further information on the Association of Genies and its efforts to safeguard the world from the dangers of uncontrolled wishes, please visit www.associationofgenies.org.

About the Association of Genies (AOG)

The Association of Genies is the foremost international authority on genie ethics and wish management. Founded in 1001 AD, the AOG has been dedicated to promoting responsible wish-granting practices for over a millennium. The organization is committed to ensuring the harmonious coexistence of genies and humanity while preventing the reckless use of wishes that may have catastrophic consequences.
